What are Fluxes?

An ordinary magnet sticks on one face and pushes away on the other. Fluxes stick on both. Every ring snaps to every other ring, whichever way you flip it, so they behave in ways your hands do not expect.

That small surprise makes them a fidget that never gets old: smooth and calming to play with alone, and a game or a puzzle the moment someone else picks one up.
